description: NaLi₂MnCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.83 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.26 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.23 Å. Mn is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.60 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Li, and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaLi₂C tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing OLi₂MnP trigonal pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom.
